note: Costa Rica: the listed nationals enter without a visa for 180 days or 30; everyone else needs a consular visa, or one approved by the Commission for Restricted Visas (Afghanistan, Cuba, Haiti, Jamaica and others), which the game doesn't tell apart. A 30-day entry on a valid Canadian, Schengen or US multiple-entry visa isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
